newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong ups price on Laguna Verde.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong ups price on Laguna Verde.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said it would offer an additional 125 units in its Laguna Verde residential development for sale at HK$8,787 per square foot, compared with an initial price of HK$8,286 per square foot.

Cheung Kong said there were about 2,000 potential buyers registered to buy an initial 78 units on offer following the first and second day of registration on Sunday, representing 25 times the number of flats put for sale.
About 90 percent of the buyers were registered under their own names while about 10 percent were registered under company names, it said in a statement.
Registration for potential buyers will close on March 19. The units will put for sale on March 22.
Laguna Verde is a joint venture development between Cheung Kong and China Light and Power Co Ltd.
The size of the flats on offer in the development in Hunghom ranges from 500 to 1,500 square feet per unit.
The Phase I development of the project comprises 740 units and is scheldued to be completed by August 1997.
